_about: Source of docs/publications.html (tools/build_publications.py). Add a paper with at least its doi (or arxiv) and run the script with --refresh to fill in the metadata from CrossRef. 'bibcode' gives a direct ADS link when known; otherwise the ADS link is a search on the DOI.
